newsitem.title: USA: Heuristic Development says COO, CEO resign.
newsitem.headline: Heuristic Development says COO, CEO resign.

text.p: Heuristic Development Group Inc said Wednesday its chief executive Steven Gumins and its chief operating officer Deborah Griffin will resign effective May 31.
Heuristic said Greg Zink, who is president of the company, will become acting chief executive. The company was not immediately available to say who will replace Griffin.
The company said Gumins has said he plans to devote his time to outside interests in the restaurant business. He has agreed to serve as a consultant to the company through September 1997.
The company said Griffin will continue to serve as adviser to the president through the end of the year. It did not say why Griffin resigned.
The company reported a loss of $648,000 for the first quarter of 1997 compared with a loss of $286,000 for the same period a year ago.
The company said the 1997 figure reflects a $392,000 non-cash charge representing costs arising from the repayment of notes issued in a bridge financing.
The company said it did not expect to mount a significant sales and marketing program until the fourth quarter of 1997.
